title: Dear developer
body:
Dear developer

Thank you so much for developing such a nice application to set up daily routines. 

As a user, the app would be much more helpful to users if there is a linkage between  the account of their phones and i-pad or other apple tools. If so, people would be able to check out or add-up the work on the Me+ app with their phone or i-pad simultaneously. 

Wishing for the approval, one of the advocating users.
